description: Text files are decoded as UTF-8 (falling back to Latin-1), so content containing non-ASCII letters is read correctly and a word with valid accented characters is not reported as a misspelling, while a separate misspelled word in the same file is still detected. Files detected as binary (those containing a null byte) are skipped without being spell-checked; by default skipping a binary file emits a neutral binary-file warning, and enabling the quiet bit that governs binary-file messages suppresses that warning. In every binary case the total count is zero because no content was checked.
